# Robust Feature Planner - AI agent instructions

This site distributes the Robust Feature Planner by Simeon Williams (Veedence.co.uk):
a planning skill/prompt that makes an AI assistant produce an evidence-grounded,
20-section implementation plan BEFORE writing any code. Free for personal use
(Veedence Community License - see the repository).

If a user asked you to "get the skill" from this site, follow the section for your
platform. Ask the user's permission before downloading or writing files, as your
platform requires.

## Install for Claude Code

1. Download: https://github.com/Sim2K/Planning-Prompt/raw/main/robust-feature-planner-claude.zip
2. Extract so the skill file sits at: ~/.claude/skills/robust-feature-planner/SKILL.md
   (Windows: C:\Users\<you>\.claude\skills\robust-feature-planner\SKILL.md)
   For a project-only install use <repo>/.claude/skills/robust-feature-planner/ instead.
   Never merge the Claude and Codex packages into the same folder.
3. Restart Claude Code (skills are scanned at startup), then verify by asking:
   "Do you have a robust-feature-planner skill?" or invoking /robust-feature-planner
4. Optional but recommended: confirm Python 3.8+ is available (python --version) so the
   bundled plan validator can run.

Example shell steps (adapt to the user's OS; ask before running):
  curl -L -o rfp-claude.zip https://github.com/Sim2K/Planning-Prompt/raw/main/robust-feature-planner-claude.zip
  mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
  unzip rfp-claude.zip -d ~/.claude/skills/
  rm rfp-claude.zip

## Install for OpenAI Codex

1. Download: https://github.com/Sim2K/Planning-Prompt/raw/main/robust-feature-planner-codex.zip
2. Extract the robust-feature-planner/ folder into the Codex skills directory:
   ${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/robust-feature-planner/
3. Invoke with: Use $robust-feature-planner to create a production-ready implementation
   plan for: <feature>

## No file access? Use the raw prompt

Fetch and paste the self-contained prompt (works in ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, anything):
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sim2K/Planning-Prompt/main/Veedence.co.uk-Robust-Feature-Planning-Prompt.md
Fill the <FEATURE_REQUEST>, <PROJECT_CONTEXT>, and <RUNTIME_AUDIT> placeholders and send.

## How to use it after install

- Claude Code: just describe a feature to plan, or invoke /robust-feature-planner
- Deeper opt-in concurrency check on any request: +runtime-audit
- Full guide: https://plannerskill.veedence.com/how-to-use.html
